authoredFrom: Erlang call-site arity contract (ER-D2, #880 obligation 4) authored from the pinned grammar's call/expr_args shape (probed 2026-09-18) before this fixture's F3 run: a call's arity is its expr_args named-children count (comments excluded) - the same counter as a clause head - and f/1 vs f/2 call sites are DISTINCT edges (metadata.callArity); remote targets keep module qualification (ER-D1: io:format/1 and io:format/2 are distinct edges; a bare leaf would conflate every module's reply).
